_comment: sha256 of every Configuration template rjui has written into an app (lib/react/templates/Configuration.ts and js/Configuration.js, every version in the history). An app copy that is byte for byte one of them is the tool's, and rjui build replaces it with the current template; any other copy is the app's and stays (build_command#ensure_configuration_template). When the template changes, add the new file's sha256 here: spec/cli/configuration_template_refresh_spec.rb fails until the current one is listed.
